name: Air Sound
subtitle: System audio from your Mac to your iPhone.

apps.name: Air Sound
apps.subtitle: Stream your Mac's system audio over Wi-Fi.
apps.localizedDescription: Air Sound sends your Mac's system audio to your iPhone over your local Wi-Fi. Listen on the speaker, AirPods, Bluetooth, or AirPlay. No accounts, no cloud, no cables.

versions.localizedDescription: First release. Menu bar Mac app, automatic iPhone discovery, Connect by IP fallback, background playback.
